mapper.select: SELECT id, lesson_id, user_id, status FROM reservations
SELECT reservations.*, accounts.name AS user_name FROM reservations JOIN accounts ON reservations.user_id = accounts.id WHERE reservations.id = #{id}
SELECT reservations.*, accounts.name AS user_name FROM reservations JOIN accounts ON reservations.user_id = accounts.id WHERE reservations.lesson_id = #{lessonId}

SELECT reservations.id, reservations.lesson_id AS lessonId, reservations.user_id AS userId, reservations.status, lessons.title AS lessonTitle, accounts.name AS proName,
MAX(lesson_submissions.status) AS submissionStatus,
COUNT(lesson_submissions.id) AS submissionCount, COUNT( CASE WHEN lesson_submissions.status = 3 THEN 1 END ) AS completedSubmissionCount FROM reservations JOIN lessons ON reservations.lesson_id = lessons.id JOIN accounts ON lessons.pro_id = accounts.id LEFT JOIN lesson_submissions ON reservations.id = lesson_submissions.reservation_id WHERE reservations.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY reservations.id, reservations.lesson_id, reservations.user_id, reservations.status, lessons.title, accounts.name ORDER BY reservations.id DESC
SELECT id, lesson_id AS lessonId, user_id AS userId, status FROM reservations WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, lesson_id AS lessonId, user_id AS userId, status FROM reservations WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
